newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Cosipa still a sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cosipa still a sell.

text.p: ING Barings said Tuesday it has maintained its sell recommendation on shares of Brazilian steelmaker Cosipa after the release of second-quarter results.

-- ING analyst Mirela Rappaport said in a report Cosipa posted a 42 million-real loss versus a 59 million-real loss in the first quarter, excluding non-recurring items, and a forecast of a 62 million-real net loss.
-- Sales volume for the quarter was six percent below estimates and continuous casting output fell to 56 percent from 62 percent, she added.

-- In May, Cosipa granted a 5.7 percent salary increase to its 8,080 workers while operating expenses accounted fior 10 percent of total revenues versus the bank's forecast of 13 percent, rappaport said.
-- Cosipa's net debt rose 6.5 percent in the period, she said.
-- The firm's preferred B share ended down 1.64 percent at 0.60 reais while its common closed eight percent higher at 0.54 reais in Sao Paulo.
